meta.source: logo.pdf (brand violet #5438DC, white pill, JD monogram, /jpdazab wordmark) + Switzer font files; ramps, neutrals and scales derived; example1.pdf social post (canvas, ink, ink-soft, orange accent, post type styles, card geometry); juandaza.design (Framer site, saved HTML): web violet #473BF0, lavender #CAC6FA, greys #0A0A0A/#171717/#1F1F1F/#A3A3A3/#E6E6E6/#F0F0F0, yellow #FFF07C/#A39000, blue #7CA2F3, website type styles, Geist Mono, radius 32, inset shadows, glass nav, icon set; template-post.pdf (carousel card: layout, Tag, Blackbird title/labels, summary/meta greys, handle grey #919099); Cover_Main/Cover_black/Cover_black-1/Cover_yellow.pdf and Template-1–7.pdf (carousel covers and slides: electric blue #0004EB, ink #050516, pale yellow #FFFFB3, card #E6E6E6, placeholder #D9D9D9, data ink #171717, radius 16/50, slide and cover type sizes)
